ios.desc:
Manage any Pocketbase instance from your fingertips. Bring your selfhosting journey everywhere you go with POK!


▲ COLLECTIONS & RECORDS
- Browse all collections
- Search using the same syntax as the web dashboard
- Edit and Remove Records

▲ LOGS
- Browse All Logs
- Search using the same syntax as the web dashboard
- Expand Log Details

▲ BACKUPS
- Browse All Logs
- Create Backups
- Download Backups
- Restore Backups
- Remove Backups


That’s it folks!

This text isn't gonna get any more interesting. I mean, I think we've pretty much covered all the good stuff. Still here? Ummmm, ok. How's everything? Good? Cool cool cool. 

What are you looking for? The app description is over. For real, check out the app. It's way better than hanging out in the App Store this long.

Wow, you're dedicated. Do you just love app descriptions? Weird. OK, we're gonna go now. Bye.


NOTICE & ACKNOWLEDGMENT
1. Credentials are stored locally on your device, and never leave it.
2. POK is OSS (Open Source Software), feel free to open an Issue or PR at github.com/get-pok/pok
3. This is not a replacement for the Pocketbase dashboard. Certain actions, such as creating new collections, should be done directly in the web dashboard.
